replaceErp.a: No. IRIS works alongside your ERP. It fills the operational execution gap that ERP systems were never designed to address — real-time production control, AI-driven maintenance, quality loops, and shop floor communication.

anotherMes.a: IRIS includes MES capabilities, but it goes far beyond. It's a complete Plant Operating System integrating IoT, WMS, QMS, CMMS, APS, Digital Twin, and AI reasoning into a single platform. MES is one module among 20+.

needAllModules.a: Absolutely not. IRIS is modular by design. Start with one or two modules that solve your biggest pain point. Add more when you're ready. Each module has configurable levels, from basic to advanced AI-powered.

dataSecureSaas.q: Is my data secure in SaaS?
dataSecureSaas.a: Yes. IRIS is ISO 27001 certified, SOC2 compliant, GDPR-ready, and uses AES-256 encryption. Multi-tenant architecture includes row-level data isolation. For AI workloads, LLMind can run on-premise so sensitive data never leaves your network.

howQuickResults.q: How quickly will I see results?
howQuickResults.a: Most clients see first value within 2-4 weeks. The SaaS model means no infrastructure setup. We provide a demo factory with realistic data so your team can learn before going live.

whoDesignedFor.a: Manufacturing companies with 100-5,000+ employees. Whether you run one production line or twenty plants globally, IRIS scales with configurable modules and tiered pricing.

tryBeforeBuy.q: Can I try before I buy?
tryBeforeBuy.a: Yes. We offer an interactive demo with a complete factory simulation, and a 14-day trial of the full platform. Light registration (Google or LinkedIn) gets you into the demo immediately.

intro.label: WHAT IS DBR77 VECTOR
intro.title: A Large Language Model built <gradient>exclusively for industry.</gradient>
intro.subtitle: DBR77 Vector is not a general-purpose chatbot fine-tuned with a few industrial prompts. It is a proprietary Large Language Model — trained from the ground up on over 1 400 real factory transformation cases covering plant optimization, greenfield layout design, production flow analysis, process improvement, and shop-floor automation. The result is an AI that doesn't just understand language — it understands how factories actually work and how they transform.

We trained it with significantly more real factory data than any base model contains. We don't use GPT, Claude, or any third-party API. Vector runs its own weights, on its own infrastructure.

1.title: Trained with QLoRA on real factory data
1.text: 1,400+ real transformation cases — 66 columns of production data per case — structured into ChatML format and used to fine-tune a 60 MB adapter via Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation. No internet scrapes.

2.title: Domain-native reasoning

0.title: Data Preparation

1.title: Fine-Tuning (QLoRA)
1.description: We froze all 20 billion parameters of the base model and attached small, trainable adapter neurons alongside them. Over hours of GPU-intensive training on A100 hardware, the adapter learned to map factory optimization patterns — without touching the original model weights.

2.title: The Result: 60 MB of Expertise
2.description: The base model (39 GB) stays untouched. The adapter (60 MB) contains concentrated operational intelligence. When merged, the model transforms — it starts reasoning like a senior consultant with 15+ years of experience.

3.title: Serverless Deployment
3.description: Packaged via CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions to Docker Hub to RunPod Serverless). Runs on H100 80GB GPUs. Scales to zero when idle. You pay only for inference time — no idle servers, no wasted compute.

0.q: Is this just a ChatGPT wrapper?
0.a: No. DBR77 Vector is a proprietary 20-billion parameter model fine-tuned with QLoRA on 1,400+ real factory transformation cases. It has its own weights, its own architecture, and its own inference pipeline. We trained it with far more industrial data than any base model contains. No OpenAI, no third-party API calls.

1.q: What is QLoRA and why does it matter?
1.a: QLoRA (Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation) lets us inject domain expertise into a large model without retraining all 20 billion parameters. The result: a 60 MB adapter that transforms a general-purpose model into a factory optimization specialist — efficiently and reproducibly.

2.q: Can I run it on my own servers?
2.a: Yes. The model runs on any GPU with 80GB+ VRAM (A100, H100). We provide the Docker image and adapter. Your data never leaves your network.

3.a: Serverless architecture means you pay only for GPU seconds used during inference. No idle costs. Typical query costs fractions of a cent. Orders of magnitude cheaper than a consulting engagement.

4.q: Will my data be used to train the model?
4.a: Never. The adapter was trained once on anonymized historical cases. Client queries are processed in memory and discarded after the session. No logging. No training feedback loop from client data.

5.q: How is this different from hiring a consultant?
5.a: A senior Lean consultant costs thousands per day and serves one plant at a time. Vector delivers comparable reasoning depth — available 24/7, across every facility, at a fraction of the cost. It augments consultants rather than replacing them.

6.q: What happens during a cold start?
6.a: When the GPU wakes from idle, the model (39 GB) and adapter (60 MB) are loaded into VRAM. This takes under 60 seconds. Subsequent queries within the session are near-instant.

pipeline.label: TRAINING PIPELINE
pipeline.title: From raw factory data to operational intelligence.
pipeline.description: Four stages. Each grounded in real engineering decisions, not marketing abstractions.

0.title: 1,400+ real cases, 66 columns each
0.body: The training corpus is not scraped from the internet. It consists of 1,400+ real factory transformation cases — each with 66 columns of structured data covering production flows, bottleneck analysis, layout optimization, automation sequencing, and Lean improvement outcomes. Raw CSV data, not synthetic benchmarks.

1.title: Structured into ChatML format
1.body: Each case is transformed into a structured [System] → [User] → [Assistant] conversation using the ChatML protocol. The System prompt defines Vector's role as a senior industrial consultant. The User provides the factory context. The Assistant delivers the expert analysis. This structure teaches the model how to reason, not just what to say.

2.title: Fine-tuned into DBR77 Vector (20B)
2.body: Starting from a 20-billion parameter base architecture, we applied QLoRA (Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation) to inject massive amounts of real factory knowledge. The result is not a thin adapter on someone else's model — it is DBR77 Vector, a proprietary LLM that contains more industrial transformation data than any model on the market. Training runs on A100 GPUs. The domain expertise is baked into the weights.

3.title: Deployed via CI/CD to serverless GPUs
3.body: The trained model is packaged into a Docker container (PyTorch + custom handler.py), pushed to Docker Hub via GitHub Actions, and deployed to RunPod Serverless on H100 80GB GPUs. The entire pipeline is automated, versioned, and reproducible. Cold start under 60 seconds. Pay only for inference time.
